name: Omni Amelia Island Resort
insider_take: This oceanfront paradise sits on a barrier island where wild horses once roamed free, offering 3.5 miles of pristine beach and championship golf designed by legends.
whats_special: The resort features two Pete Dye-designed golf courses and sits on historic Amelia Island, Florida's only destination where you can horseback ride on the beach. The island boasts 13 blocks of Victorian-era buildings in nearby Fernandina Beach, one of the South's most walkable historic districts.
pro_tip: Book a sunset horseback ride on the beach - Amelia Island is one of only a few places in Florida where this magical experience is permitted year-round.
dont_miss: Explore Fort Clinch State Park's Civil War fortress, stroll the tree-canopied streets of Fernandina Beach's historic district, and catch the famous wild shrimp boats returning to the harbor at sunset from the resort's Nature Center.
pros: Oceanfront location with private beach access
Multiple dining options and full-service spa
Family-friendly with kids' programs and activities
cons: Remote island location requires planning for off-property dining
